dedupe_keys.name: austria bev address register free relational snapshot tables and geocoded building project notifications

description: Bundesamt für Eich- und Vermessungswesen (BEV), Austria publishes the free snapshot tables of the Austrian address register, the official address stock kept by the municipalities and issued by the BEV, where each address has an unchangeable address code, uniform attributes (for example building function), an assignment of building to address and a coordinate; the downloads page lists zips of address tables with geocoding in several variants (file names carry the suffixes 1M, 10M and 250M, which the pages read do not explain, and variants with no geocoding), street, locality, municipality and census-district directories and geocoded building-project notifications. Coverage: Austria nationally; the page describes a "current" snapshot of April 2022 with a change of the snapshot dates from October 2022, so the free snapshot may be older than the maintained register. Format and access: zipped table files downloadable without registration from the BEV website. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0) for the relational snapshot tables (page statement); licences of the other files on the downloads page were not read; cost: free. Caveats: the free relational tables are periodic snapshots and the page dates the current one to April 2022; the licence statement covers only the relational snapshot product; the zips were not opened, so table columns and record counts are unconfirmed; the full maintained register is a separate BEV product. Simulation uses: address and building-function reference tables to geocode exposure data, allocate population to buildings and join permits and parcels in flood, heat and urban growth models. Related catalogue records: BEV Digitales Landschaftsmodell (DLM): Austria-wide vector landscape model with transport, structures and buildings layers (data-austria-bev-digital-landscape-model-dlm); Österreichischer Kataster: Austrian cadastre web application of the BEV (data-bev-austrian-cadastre-viewer); OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
